messages:
Eli: Heads-up: ran into a couple broken assets while doing a small edit sweep in /kb/runtime. Two cases: a 403 on an old S3 path, and an external gist shortlink that 404s intermittently. Scanner flagged them as low-sev but no owners listed. Can someone volunteer to fix and batch any similar ones? 

Tara: Yep. Can you paste an example thread or file path? i'll triage and maybe do a PR today.

Eli: Example page: /kb/runtime/connection-retries.md — image `https://legacy-s3.redwood/private/diag/retry.png` returns 403 and the line references `https://gist.github.com/anna/abcdef` which is gone. Curl shows: 
```
$ curl -sI https://legacy-s3.redwood/private/diag/retry.png
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
```

samir: I can take a pass. Plan: rehost images to /assets/docs/runtime and replace gist with our snippets repo. Quick local commands: 
```
# find occurrences and replace path
rg "legacy-s3.redwood" -n docs/kb/runtime | cut -d: -f1 | uniq
# then sed replace on affected files
sed -i "s|https://legacy-s3.redwood/private/diag/retry.png|/assets/docs/runtime/retry.png|g" <file>
```
I'll also add a tiny frontmatter redirect so old shortlink resolves (if someone relies on it).

docs-bot: Automated scan: orphan-image detected in /kb/runtime/connection-retries.md (confidence: medium). No CODEOWNERS matched.

Tara: When you rehost, add alt text and a short caption so the a11y linter doesn't fail. Also, convert gist -> snippet include (we have a `{{< include-snippet "runtime/retries" >}}` macro).

samir: Good catch. Will add `alt: "retry diag"` and use the include macro. ETA: 4pm PT. Will open PR and post link here.

infra-bot: Note: if you add new assets to /assets/docs you might hit the bucket policy block in CI. If CI rejects the upload, run `@infra` tag in the PR or ping infra-ops for a one-off allowlist.

Eli: Thanks. If folks see more of these, drop them here and we'll do a small batch. Might be worth running a quick ripgrep across the kb to find more legacy-s3 occurrences.

samir: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4987 — rehosted two images, migrated two gist snippets into snippets repo, added frontmatter redirect entries and captions. Requesting review from @Tara.

Tara: Reviewing now. Small nit: move the snippet file under `snippets/runtime/` and name it `retries-commands.md` so tests pick it up. Also please add a short changelog line in the PR body.

samir: Done. Renamed snippet and added changelog. CI docs build passed. Leaving infra allowlist note in PR just in case.

Eli: Excellent, thanks both. I'll run a quick ripgrep and post any other hits in this thread so we can batch follow-ups. :thumbsup:
